# The skipped virtual-folder test uses a child URI for its parent callback

The outer folder-pane test waits for virtualFolderListEdit.xhtml but passes a callback that clicks folderListPicker in the parent properties dialog. At this landing cmd_newVirtualFolder opens virtualFolderProperties.xhtml; that parent's chooser then opens ListEdit. The migration gives parent and child watchers the same URI. The file is explicitly skipped by its manifest at the landing and fixed accepted revision, so the mismatch is a latent source finding with no live timeout or correctness result.

Scope: Virtual folder dialog test ownership.
